item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses two offline DummyLMs, sets `global_lm` via `dspy.configure`, and applies `france_lm` only inside `forward` with `dspy.context`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Runs the same `CountryProgram` on exactly two inputs, France and Germany, through `dspy.Parallel(num_threads=2)`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Includes `time.sleep(0.2)` during each call, keeping executions overlapped while the override context is active."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `answers == [\"Paris\", \"Berlin\"]`, showing France used the override LM and Germany used the default LM."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Prints and asserts `dspy.settings.lm is global_lm` after parallel execution, verifying no override leaked back to the main thread."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
